en.title: Mark Wahlberg's Sci-Fi Thriller 'Infinite' Vanishes From Free Streaming Soon
en.summary: A forgotten sci-fi action flick starring Mark Wahlberg is set to disappear from free streaming platforms. Fans have a limited window to catch this high-concept thriller before it's gone.
en.body:
## A Cosmic Goodbye to Free Streaming

For those who enjoy a good sci-fi romp with a dash of existential pondering, a specific Mark Wahlberg vehicle is about to take its final bow on free streaming. **Infinite**, the ambitious 2021 sci-fi action thriller, will officially depart the free-to-watch service Tubi at the end of September 2026. This marks the end of its availability on the platform, leaving fans scrambling if they haven't caught it already or wish for a rewatch.

The film dives into a fascinating premise: a secret society known as the Infinites, individuals who have been reincarnated across centuries and retain all their memories and skills. This unique characteristic makes them incredibly powerful, capable of mastering any craft or weapon. The narrative follows Evan McCauley (Wahlberg), who discovers he is one of these extraordinary beings. He is then thrust into a hidden war between two factions of Infinites: the Believers, who seek to use their eternal lives for the betterment of humanity, and the Nihilists, who have grown weary of existence and wish to end the cycle, even at the cost of all life. Directed by Antoine Fuqua, known for his work on **Training Day** and **The Equalizer** series, the film boasts a high-octane visual style and a concept ripe for exploration.

## The Fate of the 'Infinite' Fanbase

While **Infinite** may not have reached the box office heights of Wahlberg's **Transformers** ventures or garnered the critical acclaim of his Oscar-nominated roles, its presence on a free streaming service offered a low-barrier entry point for many. The film's departure from Tubi means that accessing it will likely require a subscription to another platform or a digital purchase, a common frustration for viewers who enjoyed its availability. The concept of the Infinites, with their accumulated knowledge and skills, offers a unique take on immortality, and its temporary accessibility highlights the ever-changing landscape of digital content. For fans of Wahlberg's more action-oriented roles or those intrigued by multiverse-style narratives, this is a reminder to seize the opportunity before it's gone.

## What's Next for 'Infinite'

With **Infinite** leaving Tubi, its future streaming availability remains uncertain. Fans are advised to check other major streaming services or rental platforms for potential listings. Details regarding its next destination have not yet been announced.
